sources.entry: Time to Leave - Log work hours and get notified when it's time to leave the office and start to live.

summary.one_liner: A desktop app that logs your start time, computes when you should leave the office after accounting for lunch, and notifies you when it's time to go.
summary.what_it_does: You log the time you started working today, and the program calculates the time you should leave, factoring in the time spent on lunch. When that time arrives, it sends a notification. Preferences let you set your working days, how many hours you work per day, and whether you want notifications. You can also add waivers for days you did not work. The README says it runs on MacOS, Windows and Linux, with installers available from the latest release. The README is brief and does not describe the build process beyond pointing to contributing and development guides.
use_cases: get reminded when to leave work
set custom working days and hours
how_to_run: Download the desired version from the latest release on the GitHub releases page
notable: Computes a leave-by time from your start time and lunch break
Sends a notification when it is time to leave
Configurable working days and daily hours
caveats: README does not name the implementation language or framework
Installation is described only as downloading from the latest release; no build steps are given in the README
License not stated in the README
